keyEvents.text: Goal! Norwich City 0, Watford 1. Myron Boadu (Watford) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Iker Bravo following a fast break.

Goal! Norwich City 0, Watford 2. Myron Boadu (Watford) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mattie Pollock with a through ball following a fast break.
Mattie Pollock (Watford) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Norwich City 0, Watford 2.
Second Half begins Norwich City 0, Watford 2.
Goal! Norwich City 1, Watford 2. Ben Chrisene (Norwich City) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Substitution, Watford. Marc Bola replaces Branimir Mlacic.
Goal! Norwich City 2, Watford 2. Anthony Musaba (Norwich City) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Mathias Kvistgaarden.
José Córdoba (Norwich City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Norwich City 3, Watford 2. Paris Maghoma (Norwich City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mathias Kvistgaarden.
Substitution, Norwich City. Jovon Makama replaces Andre Brooks.
Substitution, Norwich City. Lucien Mahovo replaces Paris Maghoma.
Substitution, Watford. Omar Haktab Traoré replaces Jordan Zemura.
Substitution, Watford. Mamadou Doumbia replaces Myron Boadu.
Substitution, Norwich City. Anis Ben Slimane replaces Mathias Kvistgaarden.
Substitution, Norwich City. Darlin Yongwa replaces Anthony Musaba.
Substitution, Watford. Rocco Vata replaces Martín Payero.
Substitution, Watford. Othmane Maamma replaces Krépin Diatta.
Substitution, Norwich City. Kellen Fisher replaces Jack Stacey.
Second Half ends, Norwich City 3, Watford 2.
